THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
098
STUDY 047
Gray Bow Knit & Black Boots
Rights check
Source: 24383.jpg
Refined, playful, structured
WORKING NOTES
- The oversized tied bow and combat boots are the
signature details.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
wavy hair stands in a full-length pose
against a pale gray studio backdrop.
She wears a gray ribbed knit top with an
oversized tied bow at the neck and
buttons down the side, layered over a
black gathered mini skirt. Sheer gray
tights and cream ribbed socks show
above tall black lace-up combat boots.
She holds a black structured handbag
with a small red charm. Her expression
is calm and direct. Soft diagonal studio
light. Palette of gray, black, and cream.
Refined and playful, in the style of a
contemporary knitwear catalog.
